messages:
emily: Quick postmortem from today's rollout: TS/Go SDKs started emitting `X-RD-Route` instead of `X-Route` after the refactor. Most orgs unaffected, but a handful saw quota attribution splits and dashboard tile duplicates. Repro steps attached.

rafael: Do we know which layer treated them differently? proxy, console, or downstream jobs?

emily: Initial trace shows proxy now title-cases headers, console's legacy path lowercases and expects `x-route`. When title-case hits the parser, it took an alternate path and generated a new route key.

theo: Short fix: console should normalize headers and map both keys to canonical id before aggregation. Longer fix: SDKs should be explicit about the header they emit and provide an opt-in dual emit for migration.

priya: Security note: route header only contains tenant ID and a small tag. No secrets. SOC ok with temporary duplication but wants opt-in default false.

emily: Proposal: 1) Patch console normalizer canary today (region-us-east), 2) ship SDK minor patches with flag `emitLegacyRoute` default false, 3) add org banner + dashboard metric showing legacy/new split, 4) 30-day deprecation window after traffic stabilizes.

rafael: Agree. I'll own console canary PR. Will canonicalize keys to lowercase and map `x-route`, `x-rd-route`, `x-redwood-route` -> `route_key:v1`. Dedupe by value.

sdk-bot: ci: SDK patches drafted: TS 2.3.2 (flag), Go 0.9.5 (flag). Py team to follow.

emily: Can we add a telemetry tag to requests (`route.header_migration=opt_in|opt_out|unknown`) so we can measure adoption without changing quota metrics?

theo: Good call. Add a read-only telemetry header `X-RD-Route-Migration: opt_in` emitted only when flag true. Console will use it for dashboards only and ignore for billing.

priya: SOC: ensure telemetry header is purely diagnostic and not used for auth. Also file a short notice in compliance changelog.

rafael: Canaries scheduled: console normalizer -> us-east canary 10:30 UTC, monitor 30m. If stable, roll to us-west.

emily: SDK release plan: cut TS/Go patches after console canary is healthy. Keep flags default false. Provide quick migration doc and code snippets.

theo: Add e2e in SDK CI matrix that runs the client against a staging proxy variant that title-cases headers and against a legacy lowercasing proxy. Fail if dup-quota > 0.05%.

ops-bot: alert: New canary deploy started for console-normalizer (deploy id deploy-176050-1)

rafael: Canary looks clean at +15m. No new duplicate quota spikes in staging. Rolling to us-west in 45m.

emily: After roll, we'll email org admins with the migration timeline and enable dashboard banner for orgs seeing >0.02% mixed headers. Also schedule removal of legacy emission in 30 days post-rollout.

priya: I'll prepare compliance blurb and tag enterprise customers.

emily: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: keep an eye on quotas and dashboard tiles for next 48h. If we see >0.1% drift, we revert SDK changes and rollback proxy title-case normalization.

rafael: ack.
